# Sourdough starter

Notes on keeping the starter alive after the winter it nearly died.

## Feeding

Discard all but 50 g, then add 50 g flour and 50 g lukewarm water. Twice a day
when it lives on the counter, once a week when it lives in the fridge. A 1:1:1
ratio by weight keeps it predictable.

## Signs it is ready to bake

It should roughly double within 4 to 6 hours of a feed, smell tangy rather than
like nail polish, and a spoonful should float in water.

## When it goes wrong

Grey liquid on top ("hooch") means it is hungry, not dead. Pour it off and feed
it. Pink or orange streaks mean contamination: throw it out and start over.
